title: Early-building pictures gain clearer credits and evidence limits
items: St Mary's exact 1884 engraving is credited without inventing an 1843 image date; the current tower-absence choice is disclosed as inference.
Beaubien's card separates the sale-located homestead from the older Factory House and labels the panorama identification unresolved.
The jail drawing is now credited to W. E. S. Trowbridge in Gale’s verified 1902 book, a public-domain source. Its 1836 caption and the separate UCR copy’s date and rights remain distinct.
The loading card now describes St Mary's uncertain steeple date. These corrections preserve July 1835 forms; the original picture-match cases remain open.
